reuse.why: Adds one guard used by all five provider link functions and leaves the existing link flow as it is; the tree offers no shared link pipeline to hook into instead.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in assertNotLinkedElsewhere; only the one-call guard with a provider literal repeats across the already-parallel link functions.

placement.why: Sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers it guards; link.ts, home of the other linking DB helper findOrCreateBank, would be an equally natural place.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single named guard with the re-link exemption as a parameter is easy to own; a new provider must still remember to call it in its own link function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link function calls the guard before creating banks or accounts or contacting the sync server.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; repeated lines are call sites only.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all five provider link functions.
